eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; Pima, AZ; at 3:32 PM on AUG 1, 2026 Effective until 11:32 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A safe Alert has been issued for Pima County. The Pima County Sheriff is looking for 66-year-old Debra E. Esarey. Debra is a white female 5 feet 5 inches tall, 120 pounds, with hazel eyes and blonde hair. Debra was last seen wearing a blue and white striped shirt, black pants, and a black ball cap. Debra was last seen on 07/29/2026 at 9:30 A.M. on foot near 6225 West Ajo Way, Tucson. Debra suffers from a medical condition which may cause her to become lost or easily confused. Please call 911 with information. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
